10. Rehab. Staff to assist property owner to select one of the city-owned houses. Payment to City Property Department for house to come from Relocation Office Escrow Account.
11. Rehab. Staff responsible for obtaining all plans, clearances, variances, permits, etc., necessary for the move. All payments to be requested from Relocation Office Escrow Account.
12. Upon completion of all plans and the obtaining of all clearances, the job is placed out to bid for: 
a) Demolition
b) Moving
c) Rehabilitation
13. Upon acceptance of a bid by the property owner, the final package is submitted to the loan committee for approval.
14. Notice to Proceed issued to contractors upon loan committee approval.
15. Rehab. Staff to make progress inspections and authorize progress payments from balance of Escrow Account and/or CDBG loan/grant funds or other funds.
16. Rehab. Technician to make final inspection and file Notice of Completion with County Recorder's Office.
17. Rehab. Staff to notify Central Relocation Office when rehab work has been completed.
